y-m-23-08.title: Kugadzira ma decimals anotanga kudzokorora gare gare
y-m-23-08.topic: Ma fractions anotanga kudzokorora gare gare
y-m-23-08.goal: Siyanisa ma fractions ane, kana akanyorwa semadecimals, chikamu chekumberi chinopera uye chikamu chekumashure chinodzokororwa, uye udhiziine iwe pachako ma fractions akadaro kuti uwane chii chakafanana pamadenominator awo.
y-m-23-08.material: Kana ma fractions akanyorwa semadecimals, mamwe anodzokorora kubva pa decimal place yekutanga, sa 1/3 = 0.333…; mamwe, sa 1/6 = 0.1666…, ane 1 pa place yekutanga isiri chikamu chekudzokorora uye 6 inodzokorora kubva pa place yechipiri zvichienda mberi. Kune ma decimals anopera zvakare, sa 1/4 = 0.25. Mubasa iri, unobata ma fractions a/b chete apo a < b ≤ 60.
y-m-23-08.thinking.0: Kufungidzira hukama pakati pechimiro chedenominator yefraction nechimiro che decimal yayo
y-m-23-08.thinking.1: Kugadzira iwe pachako ma fractions anoenderana nemamiriro
y-m-23-08.thinking.2: Kuwana chii chakafanana mumienzaniso yawakagadzira uye kufungidzira kuti sei
y-m-23-08.prereq.2: Ma fractions ari mu lowest terms nema common divisors
y-m-23-08.s.s1.prompt: Kana ma fractions akanyorwa semadecimals, ndeapi anotanga kudzokorora kwete pa decimal place yekutanga asi mushure mayo? (Sa 1/6 = 0.1666…, apo digit imwe kana mbiri dzekumberi hadzisi chikamu chekudzokorora.) Sarudza ese.
y-m-23-08.s.s1.hint.0: Shandisa kupatsanura kuti uwane fraction imwe neimwe kusvika pa decimal places 4.
y-m-23-08.s.s1.hint.1: Uchitarisa decimal places 4, maka pakatanga kudzokorora.
y-m-23-08.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga 0.1666…. Place yekutanga i 1, uye 6 inodzokorora kubva pa place yechipiri.
y-m-23-08.s.s1.r.b: Wakafunga 0.111…. Kudzokorora kunotanga pakarepo kubva pa place yekutanga.
y-m-23-08.s.s1.r.c: Wakafunga 0.05. Decimal iyi inopera uye haidzokorori.
y-m-23-08.s.s1.r.d: Wakafunga 0.08333…. 3 inodzokorora kubva pa place yechitatu.
y-m-23-08.s.s1.r.e: Wakafunga 0.142857…. 142857 inodzokorora kubva pa place yekutanga.
y-m-23-08.s.s1.explain: 1/6 = 0.1666… ne 1/12 = 0.08333… vane places dzekumberi dzisiri chikamu chekudzokorora. 1/9 ne 1/7 vanodzokorora pakarepo kubva pa place yekutanga, uye 1/20 = 0.05 i decimal inopera.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira ma fractions a/b 3 akasiyana (a ne b i natural numbers, a < b ≤ 60) anoenderera nekusingaperi kana akanyorwa semadecimals uye anotanga kudzokorora mushure mePlace yekutanga ye decimal, kwete payo. (Ma fractions ane mutengo wakafanana anoverengwa seimwechete. Muenzaniso: 1/6 ne 2/12 i imwechete.)
y-m-23-08.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora fraction imwe neimwe sedecimal rimwe pachimwe uye uunganidze mutebhura pakatanga kudzokorora.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ayapatsanure kuita mapoka maviri, anotanga kudzokorora pakarepo nanotanga kudzokorora gare gare, uye uenzanise ma denominator.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.ok.c1: a i natural number i 1 kana kupfuura uye a < b ≤ 60.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Ita a ne b natural numbers ne a < b ≤ 60.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Inoenderera nekusingaperi kana yanyorwa se decimal.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.fail.c2: I nhamba inopera kana yanyorwa se decimal. Sarudza fraction inoenderera nekusingaperi.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.ok.c3: Kudzokorora kunotanga mushure me place yekutanga, kwete payo.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Kudzokorora kunotanga pakarepo kubva pa decimal place yekutanga. Tsvaga nhamba ine places dzekumberi dzisiri chikamu chekudzokorora.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.explain: 1/6 = 0.1666…, 1/12 = 0.08333…, 1/15 = 0.0666…, 7/30 = 0.2333…, ne 1/14 = 0.0714285714285… zvose zvine places dzekumberi dzisiri chikamu chekudzokorora. Chiitiko chese apo, mu lowest terms, denominator ine 2 kana 5 uye ine prime factor isiri 2 ne 5 chinoenderana.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.because.prompt: Nyora kuti ma denominator (mu lowest terms) ema fractions awakagadzira ane chii chakafanana, uye ufungidzire uye unyore kuti sei ma fractions akadaro anotanga kudzokorora gare gare.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.because.hint.0: Deredza ma fractions awakagadzira kuita lowest terms uye urongedze ma denominator awo pamwe chete.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.because.hint.1: Aise padivi pema denominator ema fractions anotanga kudzokorora pakarepo uye uwane musiyano.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Unoona chimwechete chakafanana mu fractions ese awakagadzira here?
y-m-23-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakaenzanisa nema denominator ema fractions anotanga kudzokorora pakarepo here?
y-m-23-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Fungidziro yako ye 'sei' yakabatana nehumbowo here (semuenzaniso, mamiriro edenominator emadecimals anopera)?
y-m-23-08.s.s2.because.model.0: Denominator ine 2 kana 5 mairi uye ine imwe nhamba sa 3. 6, 12, 15, ne 30 zvose zvakadaro. Kana pane 2 ne 5 chete inopera, uye kana pane 3 chete inodzokorora pakarepo, saka kana marudzi maviri akasanganiswa, kumberi kunopera uye kumashure kunodzokorora, zvinoratidzika.
y-m-23-08.s.s2.because.model.1: Sa 6, 14, 15, i ma multiple e 2 kana 5 uye zvakare ma multiple e 3 kana 7. Marudzi maviri akasanganiswa, saka chikamu chekumberi chinopera uye chekumashure chinodzokorora.

Izvozvi nhamba 10 chete dzinoratidzwa, saka unofanirawo kuongorora nemaremainders ekugovanisa kuti kudzokorora kunoenderera chaizvo se5, 7, 1, 4, 2, 8.

y-m-23-01.title: Mhinduro yaJiho yakabuda mumutsetse pai?
y-m-23-01.goal: Mumhinduro inonyora repeating decimal se fraction, wana mutsetse apo mutengo unorasirwa pasina chikonzero, tarisa kukanganisa nekushandura mhedzisiro kudzokera kunhamba yekutanga, wobva wagadzirisa zvakarurama.
y-m-23-01.material: Jiho akaedza kunyora x = 0.4555… (nhamba yekutanga yedhesimali i4, uye kubva panhamba yechipiri yedhesimali 5 inodzokororwa nokusingaperi) sefraction yakapfupika, ndokugadzirisa sezvinotevera. Mitsara yekugadzirisa yakanyorwa nhamba kubva pamutsara 1 kusvika pamutsara 4. Kana ichiverengwa inonzi 'zero point four five five five …, ne5 inodzokororwa'.
y-m-23-01.thinking.0: Kuongorora kana mutsara wega wega wekugadzirisa unotevera chaizvo kubva pamutsara wakangotangira
y-m-23-01.thinking.2: Kugadzirisa kukanganisa uye kuenzanisa nekugadzirisa kumwe
y-m-23-01.prereq.0: Zvinoreva madhesimali anopera nemadhesimali anodzokororwa, nechikamu chinodzokororwa (chikamu chinodzokororwa mushure meponti yedhesimali)
y-m-23-01.prereq.1: Kuwanza mativi ose maviri nenhamba imwe chete kunochengeta equation iri yechokwadi (ukuru hwemaequation emutsetse)
y-m-23-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe wekugadzirisa kwaJiho une chikonzero chisina kururama. (Mitsara inoverengwa ichitanga pa1.)
y-m-23-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bvisa madhesimali emutsara 1 nemutsara 2 iwe amene, uye uongorore chaizvo kuti nhamba dzipi dzinosara mushure meponti yedhesimali.
y-m-23-01.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa nenzira kana mutsara wega wega unotevera chaizvo kubva pamutsara wakangotangira, uye kana pane mutsara une kukosha kwakachinjwa zvakavanzika.
y-m-23-01.s.s1.line.2: Chikamu chedhesimali .1 chidiki, saka chitore sechisina: 99x = 45
y-m-23-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 3 ndiwo unoenda zvisirizvo. Kusvika mutsara 2, zvikamu zvinodzokororwa mushure meponti yedhesimali zvinodzimana, saka 99x = 45.1 inobuda chaizvo. Asi mumutsara 3, .1 yakarasirwa nokuti idiki. Muequation, kana ukarasa kunyange nhamba diki, equation haichashandi. Saka 5/11 yemutsara 4 i0.4545…, inosiyana nenhamba yekutanga 0.4555… panzvimbo yechitatu yedhesimali. Kana wakasarudza mutsara 1 kana 2: kuverenga kwe100x nechikamu chayo chedhesimali kwakarurama chaizvo.
y-m-23-01.s.s2.prompt: Kana uchikahadzika kana mhinduro yaJiho 5/11 yakarurama, nzira inokurumidza zvikuru yekuongorora usina kutarisa kugadzirisa zvakare ndeipi?
y-m-23-01.s.s2.hint.0: Pasarudzo yega yega, nyora 'zvairi kushandisa' kuongorora, uye ufunge kuti chinhu chipi chaunogona kushandisa usina kuverenga kugadzirisa zvakare.
y-m-23-01.s.s2.hint.1: Govanisa 5 ne11 uye uenderere nekuverenga kusvika panzvimbo ina dzedhesimali.
y-m-23-01.s.s2.o.a: Chinja 99 kuita 100 uye uverenge zvakare nenzira imwe chete
y-m-23-01.s.s2.r.a: Iyi inzira yekuchinja nhamba kusvika zvaita kana kuverenga kusingaenderani. Kana pasina chikonzero chekuchinja, haugoni kuziva kana mhinduro yakarurama.
y-m-23-01.s.s2.o.b: Mhinduro ifraction inoita yakareruka, saka ndinoitora seyakarurama
y-m-23-01.s.s2.r.b: Kuva fraction muchimiro chakareruka chinhu chakasiyana nekukosha kwayo kuri kwechokwadi. Kunyange fraction yakapfupika inogona kusarurama.
y-m-23-01.s.s2.r.c: Wakafunga kuongorora nekudzorera mhinduro kunhamba yekutanga. Inzira yekuongorora uchishandisa mugumisiro panzvimbo pekuvimba nenzira yekugadzirisa.
y-m-23-01.s.s2.explain: Kana ukadzorera mhinduro kudhesimali, 5/11 = 0.4545…, inosiyana ne0.4555… panzvimbo yechitatu yedhesimali. Kana ukaenzanisa mugumisiro nemamiriro ekutanga nenzira iyi, unogona kuziva kuti pane kukanganisa usina kuverenga kugadzirisa zvakare.
y-m-23-01.s.s3.prompt: Nyora kuti mutsara 3 unofanira kugadziriswa sei, wobva wawana kukosha kwe x sefraction yakapfupika. Kana wakagadzirisa nenzira imwe, unogona kushandisa nzira iyoyo.
y-m-23-01.s.s3.hint.0: Chengeta kukosha kwakarasirwa mumutsara 3, uye unyore zvakare kuti 99x inoenzana nei.
y-m-23-01.s.s3.hint.1: Wanza mativi ose maviri nenhamba imwe chete kuti nhamba dzakazara chete dzisare, uye uongorore kana nhamba mbiri idzi dzine divisor yakafanana.
y-m-23-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakadzorera fraction yako kudhesimali ukaongorora kuti inoenzana ne0.4555… here?
y-m-23-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura nemashoko ako kuti nei kukosha kwakarasirwa kunochinja mugumisiro here?
y-m-23-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Kana wakagadzirisa nenzira imwe, wakaenzanisa kana mhinduro dzenzira mbiri dzakafanana here?
y-m-23-01.s.s3.model.0: Mumutsara 3 haufanire kurasa .1; unofanira kuchengeta 99x = 45.1. Kuwanza mativi ose maviri ne10 kunopa 990x = 451, uye x = 451/990 = 41/90.
y-m-23-01.s.s3.model.1: 10x = 4.555… ne100x = 45.555…, saka 100x − 10x = 41, 90x = 41, uye x = 41/90. Pasina kurasa chikamu chedhesimali, bvisa maequation maviri ane zvikamu zvinodzokororwa zvakafanana.
y-m-23-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Imwe nzira: bvisa maequation akagadziridzwa kuti zvikamu zvinodzokororwa zvifanane.

Mumushando uyu, akasarudza kuriedza achishandisa mafraction a/12 chete ane denominator 12 (a inhamba yechisikigo kubva pa1 kusvika pa11). y-m-23-04.title: Madhesimali Maviri Anodzokororwa Anogoverana Nhamba Dzekutanga Mashoma: Ndeipi Huru?
y-m-23-04.goal: Kana nzvimbo dzekutanga mashoma dzakafanana, ongorora kuti ungasarudza riini kuti rimwe pamadhesimali maviri anodzokororwa ihuru, uchishandisa nzvimbo yekutanga apo anosiyana nekuenzanisa mafraction, uchigadzirisa kutonga kwako nekuvimba kwako.
y-m-23-04.material: A ne B zvose madhesimali anodzokororwa asingaperi anotanga ne4 panzvimbo yekutanga yedhesimali ne5 panzvimbo yechipiri yedhesimali. Ndichakuudza kuti anoenderera sei mushure meizvozvo, chidimbu chimwe panhanho imwe neimwe.

y-m-23-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uku kutonga kwakamirira mhedziso mushure mekutarisa kusvika panzvimbo imwe chete. Wakaona kuti unofanira kutarisa nzvimbo inotevera.

y-m-23-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: B yakakura kupfuura A. Musiyano ndi1/990, uyo mudiki zvikuru
y-m-23-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakaita kuti ma fraction maviri ave nedenominator imwe chete uye wakaenzanisa ma numerator. Kunyangwe musiyano mudiki, hukama hwehukuru hahuchinji.
